notes: Port 1720 is on Chromium's unsafe-port list (ERR_UNSAFE_PORT); stack C1 was only reachable by launching the q10 sessions with --explicitly-allowed-ports=1720 via $QA/env/q10/cli.config.json (playwright-cli open --config=…).

Cloud host URLs on C1 are http://127.0.0.1:9 (also an unsafe port) → browser-side cloud calls fail with ERR_UNSAFE_PORT (equivalent to a network failure for the app); backend-side calls get ECONNREFUSED ('Unable to connect…').

Signed-in/offline states were exercised with a simulated Supabase session written to localStorage 'openpcb.auth' (valid shape, far-future expires_at, tier pro) — equivalent to a user who signed in earlier and is now offline. Real sign-in is impossible on C1.

C1 DB mutations left in place for reproduction: designer_cloud_link row for 3f9e4e24 (555 Timer LED Blinker) → cloud_design_id 11111111-…; two rotates of R1 on that design (r35); a comment 'QA-q10 offline comment' on Dual LED Blinker schematic; Assistant chats 'New chat' (OpenPCB Cloud provider) and 'Dual LED Blinker chat' (dock).
Internet-offline (as opposed to cloud-offline) was simulated with context.route(/^https?:\/\/(?!127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)/ → abort('internetdisconnected')); unrouted afterwards.

Console errors per page load — Stack A (both themes): Home 0, Settings 0, Designer Schem/PCB 0, Library 0, Assistant 0, Docs 0 (only THREE.Clock deprecation warnings + React DevTools info). C1 signed-out: Home/Settings/Designer/Library/Docs/Assistant 0 per load; Route Board/Auto Place clicks add 1× 401 each. C1 signed-in offline: Home 0, Library 0, Docs 0, Assistant 0, Designer 1 (POST cloud-link 500) per load; linked design adds a WebSocket error every ~10 s (Q10-008). No ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED spam otherwise.
